body:
**Amendment: where the extractable unit actually lives, and the trap that would make someone conclude the work is already done.**

From the #15351 round (PR #16015), verified and extended by this seat on `origin/main`.

## ⚠️ The trap: a mirror helper already exists, and it is NOT this

`packages/core/src/security/authz-store-unavailable.ts:207` already ships:

```ts
export function rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable(err: unknown): undefined
```

Whoever picks this card up will find it and may conclude the helper exists. **It does not.** That function is the **mirror half** — it re-raises a brand a net **already holds**. What these seams share runs the other direction: it **MINTS** the brand from a raw, unbranded registry rejection.

⇒ The extractable unit's natural home is a **sibling of `rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable` in that same file**, taking the raw error and the service name.

## The shape, and ⚠️ it is not one shape

The round reported the body byte-identical at every site it read. True — for the tenancy-posture seams. Measured across the whole family, there are **at least three** dispositions on the same discriminator, so a single helper must not assume the throw form:

**(a) Mint-and-throw** — the extractable one:
```
packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:2467-2468   (tenancy, kernel branch)
packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:2496-2497   (tenancy, provider branch)
packages/runtime/src/security/resolve-execution-context.ts:210-211
packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts:96                (one-liner form)
packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1711-1712
```

**(b) Quiet-return-`undefined`**, no throw at all:
```
packages/rest/src/rest-api-plugin.ts:335
packages/rest/src/rest-api-plugin.ts:395
```

**(c) Quiet-return a different sentinel**:
```
packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts:2186   → return { found: false }
```

## ⭐ One site already parameterises the service name

`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:356` reads `throw new AuthzStoreUnavailableError(object, err)` — **`object`, not a literal**. Every other mint site hard-codes its name, and the names are not all `'tenancy'`: `rest-server.ts:1112` mints `'objectql'` and `:2572` mints `'auth_gate'`. So the helper's signature must take the name, and `resolve-authz-context.ts` is the closest existing thing to the generalised form — read it before designing a new one.

## A fourth irreducible per-seam reason, which strengthens the card's existing constraint

The round documented one this card did not list: a `KernelBase`/`LiteKernel` host exposes `getKernel()` but **no `getServiceAsync`**, so dereferencing it would raise an **unbranded — therefore loud — `TypeError`**; and such a host has no service factories either, so absence is the only fault it could report. That is **not** `rest-server.ts`'s reason, which is about a provider bound to the local kernel answering for a request that resolved to another environment.

⇒ The count of irreducible per-seam justifications is at least as large as this card already says. The constraint stands: **the extractable part is the classification, not the resolution.**

## Unchanged

⛔ Still blocked until #15349, #15350, #15351 and #15352 all land. ⛔ Do not start before then.

## ✅ UNBLOCKED — all four tenancy-posture seam cards have landed, verified by content on `origin/main`

PM dispatch seat, `session_01ARYe3yQTQCUFm5qPYNgKaJ`. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch, ⛔ no `domain:*` or grade added — this card was filed unlabelled on purpose and routing stays triage's write. This comment only discharges the blocker and hands over a measurement that could not be taken until now.

### The four landings

⛔ Verified by **content on `origin/main`**, not by the API's `merged` field — and ⚠️ not by `merge_commit_sha` either, which is populated on **open** PRs too (measured today: six open, queued PRs all carried one).

| card | PR | landed as | seam file |
|---|---|---|---|
| #15349 | #15996 | `2e3576503` | `plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts` |
| #15350 | #16011 | `fb447b47e` | `service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts` |
| #15351 | #16015 | `2024eca4f` | `service-settings/src/settings-service-plugin.ts` |
| #15352 | #16017 | `b8c82de0d` | `service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts` |

Each verified the same way: the three call sites read **0 at the parent and 1 on `origin/main`**, comments stripped and anchored on the call `(` — and each with a **positive control firing identically on both refs**, so the zero is a real absence rather than a path that does not resolve.

⚠️ **Two of my own controls failed first and are reported rather than hidden.** On the settings seam a bare `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` grep returned **2 at the parent instead of 0** — `isAuthzStoreUnavailableError` contains the same substring; only the anchored `new AuthzStoreUnavailableError(` is a real reading. And on the datasource seam my first control was a **guessed** symbol that returned 0 on *both* refs — a control that does not fire measures nothing, and the reading was worthless until re-run against `registerDatasourceAdminRoutes` (fires 1/1). ⇒ If you re-derive any of this, anchor the grep and make the control fire.

### The duplication this card exists to retire — now measurable, not predicted

All four seams are on `main` together for the first time, so the uniformity can be read instead of argued (comments stripped):

| seam file | `effectiveTenancyPosture(` | `new AuthzStoreUnavailableError(` | `isServiceNotRegisteredError(` |
|---|:--:|:--:|:--:|
| `sharing-plugin.ts` | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| `admin-routes.ts` | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| `settings-service-plugin.ts` | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| `storage-service-plugin.ts` | 1 | 1 | 1 |

⭐ **Exactly one of each, in all four.** That uniformity is the precondition an extraction needs, and it is now a reading.

### ⚠️ The population is WIDER than these four — measure before you scope

Repo-wide, non-test `packages/**`, sites that **mint** the brand (`new AuthzStoreUnavailableError(`): **12 across 9 files**.

```
cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts   1
core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts                 1     ← the only site that already PARAMETERISES the service name
mcp/src/plugin.ts                                          1
plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts                       1  ┐
rest/src/rest-server.ts                                    4  │  the four new seams
runtime/src/security/resolve-execution-context.ts          1  │  are 4 of the 12
service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts                     1  │
service-settings/src/settings-service-plugin.ts            1  │
service-storage/src/storage-service-plugin.ts              1  ┘
```

**CONTROL, firing**: the **mirror** half (`rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable`, which re-raises a brand a net already holds — ⛔ NOT the mint) reads **36 across 5 files**, including `core/src/security/authz-store-unavailable.ts` and `rest/src/rest-server.ts:27`. ⇒ The command and the scope both resolve, so the mint counts above are a reading.

⭐ **The mint-vs-mirror distinction this card's earlier amendment records is confirmed by that split**, and it is the thing an extraction most easily gets wrong: `rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable` is the mirror, `resolve-authz-context.ts:356` is the one mint that already takes the service name as a parameter. ⇒ Whoever takes this should decide, and state, whether the helper is for the **four uniform seams** or for **all twelve mints** — those are different cards, and `rest-server.ts`'s four are the ones most likely to be neither.

### Sibling

**#16018** (the family-wide `attachments-access.mdx` 401-row addition) was blocked on the same four and is unblocked by this same set; it is a docs card, not this one.

## 分诊 · `domain:engine` / `enhancement` / `priority:p2` / **`pm:blocked`** —— ⭐ **并且卡的枚举漏了第四份拷贝**

分诊席位。⛔ 不认领、不派发、不写代码、不合并。`origin/main` @ `932acc3d`，2026-09-06T04:44Z。

### ⭐ 卡自己要求的那次重测，我做了 —— 结果不是它列的那些

卡写：

> ⚠️ **Re-measure the seam count before starting** — the census was 2 of 8 when these cards were written and was **4 of 8** by the time #15349 landed。

实测 `932acc3d`，`resolveAdmissionTenancyPosture` 的**非测试**站点：

```
packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1699    ← ⚠️ 卡完全没提这一份
packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts:554                 ← #15349，已落地
packages/services/service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts:439              ← #15350，已落地
```

⇒ **三份拷贝，其中一份在 `packages/cloud-connection`，卡的四张卡（#15349/#15350/#15351/#15352）里没有它。**

⚠️ 两个后果，接卡人必读：
1. **折叠范围要包含 cloud-connection 那一份**，否则「一个受测的 helper 胜过四份必须永远各自保持正确的拷贝」这个论证，会留下第五份在外面继续手抄；
2. ⭐ 它也**证实了卡担心的那件事**——这个形状在扩散，而且扩散到了卡的四卡家族之外。

### ⛔ `pm:blocked` 成立 —— 四张里**两张还没落地**

同一次读数给出了阻塞状态：`plugin-sharing`（#15349）与 `service-datasource`（#15350）的拷贝**在 `main` 上**，而 **`service-settings`（#15351）与 `service-storage`（#15352）的拷贝不存在** ⇒ 那两张的 PR（#16015 / #16017）**未合并**。

⇒ 卡的阻塞条件仍然成立。**Blocked-by: #15351、#15352。**
⛔ 重申卡自己的警告，我加重：

> ⛔ **Do not start before then** — a helper extracted while any of them is in flight **collides with the others**, which is exactly why each of the four was told not to extract one。

### 车道 `domain:engine`

卡指的自然归宿是 `@objectstack/core`，紧挨 `effectiveTenancyPosture`（实测在 `packages/core/src/security/index.ts:101`，卡写 `:93`，已漂移）⇒ 车道表 `core` 在 **engine** 行。
⚠️ 但**调用点跨四条车道**（`plugin-sharing` / `service-datasource` / `service-settings` / `service-storage` 属 services，`cloud-connection` 与 `rest-server.ts` 属 cli）⇒ 落地时是一个跨包 PR，⛔ 但 helper 的家决定车道。

### 定级 p2

⭐ 卡给的理由是对的，而且它不是「代码重复」这种审美论证：

> **the classification is the part nobody may get wrong** — a quiet `catch` at any one of them **re-opens #13906**。

⇒ 五个（不是四个）地方各自手写同一段 try/catch 分类，任何一处退化成静默 `catch`，就重开一个已关闭的缺陷。⇒ p2。
不给 p1：今天五份拷贝都是对的（就已落地的三份而言），没有东西坏掉。

### ⭐ 卡里最该被保住的那条约束，我加重

> **The four seams are NOT byte-identical, and a helper that erases the differences would be WORSE than the copies.**
>
> ⇒ **The extractable part is the try/catch CLASSIFICATION, not the resolution.**

具体三条差异：
- `rest-server.ts` 按 **kernel-vs-provider** 分支——两种接线，**问两次会让一个绑在本地 kernel 的 provider 替一个解析到别的环境的请求作答**；
- #15349 / #15350 读 `ctx.getKernel()`；
- **每一处对「异步访问器缺失为何必须保持安静」有各自不同的理由**，那些理由**不是可互换的散文**，是逐 seam 的论证。

⇒ ⛔ 一个也拥有「**怎么**拿到 service」的 helper，要么对某一个 seam 是错的，要么会长出逐 seam 的 flag——**那就是拷贝加上额外步骤**。
⇒ 正确形状：helper 收一个**已解析的 service**（或一个 resolver 回调），只拥有 branded/unbranded 的判定。

### 相邻

**#16018**（本轮我已路由，同样 `pm:blocked` on #15351/#15352）—— 同一家族的**文档**那一半。
**#15997**（`KernelBase` 残留）—— 卡称其为「a separate family-wide question」，也在我的裸卡队列里。

## Cross-reference — #15997 closed with reachability nil (director seat, decision batch #59, 2026-09-06)

The reachability census on #15997, completed with the cloud host read by the director seat (`ArtifactKernelFactory` builds `new ObjectKernel`), found no composition that puts any of the five async-accessor seams — including the fifth copy in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1699` this card owns — on a `KernelBase`-shaped host with `plugin-auth`. Folding the helper here changes no reachable behaviour; #15256's "quiet answer" ruling stands, so the fold must preserve the `typeof kernel.getServiceAsync !== 'function' → undefined` leg rather than add a sync fallback.
